bibliographic.title: The House of Ebony on the Planet Jubilee
bibliographic.author: Perry P
bibliographic.description:
The young crew of an exploration vessel finds itself in a house on an abandoned planet. Welcome to Jubilee.

A horror scifi based on a prompt, left to stew for three years, and feverishly finished in 12 hours straight.
